clarifying_questions_round_1: What application/UI is this dark mode for? The repository appears to be a Claude Code plugin (refactor plugin). Is dark mode for a web UI, CLI output, generated reports, or something else entirely?
What problem does dark mode solve for your users? Is this driven by accessibility needs, user requests, eye strain reduction, or compliance with a design system?
What is explicitly IN scope? For example: full theming infrastructure, just color swaps, or integration with an existing design token system?
What is explicitly OUT of scope? For example: custom theme creation, per-component theme overrides, high-contrast mode, auto-scheduling by time of day?
What does 'done' look like? Please describe 3+ concrete behaviors that must work for this feature to be considered complete.
Are there specific design specs, mockups, or color palettes to follow? Or should the implementation derive dark colors from the existing light theme?
How should the user activate dark mode? Options: manual toggle (button/switch), automatic system preference detection (prefers-color-scheme), both, or other?
Should the preference persist across sessions? If so, via what storage mechanism (localStorage, cookie, user profile, database)?
What should the default mode be for new users? Light mode, dark mode, or follow system preference?
How should dark mode handle images, icons, and media? Should images be inverted, have adjusted brightness, or remain unchanged?
What happens during the theme transition? Smooth CSS transition or instant swap?
What is the current styling/theming system? CSS modules, Tailwind, styled-components, CSS custom properties, SCSS, or something else?
Are there third-party components or libraries that need dark mode support?
Are there accessibility requirements? For example, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)?
Are there performance constraints? For example, theme switching must complete within X milliseconds, no FOUC (flash of unstyled content)?
Is there an existing design system or token library this should integrate with?
